name: Outbound Webhook Delivery
summary: Sign and deliver events to your users' customers: HMAC signing with rotation, backoff, per-endpoint circuit breaking, delivery log.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Branch connection string. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: OUTBOUND_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: Per-request timeout. Short by design: a slow endpoint must not hold an invocation open.

env.name: OUTBOUND_MAX_ATTEMPTS
env.description: Attempts before a delivery is dead-lettered. 12 with exponential backoff spans roughly a day.

env.name: OUTBOUND_BUDGET_MS
env.description: Stop starting new deliveries after this long, so the invocation ends cleanly.

env.name: OUTBOUND_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES
env.description: Largest event payload accepted for fan-out.

env.name: NEON_BLOCKS_TRIGGER_SECRET
env.description: Shared secret authenticating the /send cron trigger.

triggers.description: Deliver due attempts. Every minute is the practical floor for cron-driven delivery latency.
